name: QA Walk (persona friction)
description: Exploratory, persona-driven QA: drives Milepost end to end via Playwright MCP as a first-time RVer, a returning user, and a skeptic, against a freshly started dev server. Logs what happened factually, then assesses FELT FRICTION (not pass/fail), one section per persona. The walk methodology, personas, findings schema, and parser fixture are project-owned and live in the repo at team/qa/ (orchestrator.md, personas/, config/). This is the exploratory B layer; it is never a CI gate. App-startup specifics come from this project's pack under .glissa/teams/qa-walk/pack/how-to-run.md.

stages.summary: Brings up the dev server, then walks Milepost via Playwright MCP as first-timer, returning-user, and skeptic; writes one findings section per persona plus a summary.
